SAPNADIP BAIDYA 8013687055 | sapnadip.baidya.official@gmail.com | LinkedIn: sapnadipbaidya | website

SKILLS ● FRONT-END DEVELOPMENT: Micro-Frontend,svelte, React.js, React Native, Redux, Angular, NextJs, Material UI, HTML5,

CSS3, PNPM, Turborepo

BACK-END DEVELOPMENT: Java, Python, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Express.js, Node.js, FastAPI, SQL, Redis, WebSockets,

Microservices, RESTful APIs, JUnit, ClickHouse,MQTT, Eureka, NGINX, Docker

Al & ML: RAG, LLM Integration(OpenAI, Anthropic APIs),NLP,OCR, Vector Databases , Data Visualization, Generative AI, Agentic

AI, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, FAISS , Bedrock

CLOUD & DEVOPS: AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, Boto3), GCP, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD ● TOOLS & MISCELLANEOUS: Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG),Git, JIRA, Agile, Scrum, Machine Learning

EXPERIENCE 2025-Present

MARKETS AND MARKETS - Bangalore, India

SOFTWARE ENGINEER ● Engineered a secure full-stack video platform featuring a React, MUI and Framer Motion frontend with adaptive auto-quality playback,

powered by a FastAPI, Celery, and FFmpeg backend, safeguarded media delivery via 30-minute S3 presigned URLs and Cloudflare masking, with Redis and MongoDB managing state and metadata.

Developed and launched an AI-powered chatbot interface leveraging WebSockets , Event Streaming, RAG, FAISS , OpenAI,

Anthropic APIs - driving a 60% increase in customer satisfaction scores.

Fabricated LinkedIn Chrome Extension using Svelte, FastAPI, and MongoDB, enabling real-time LinkedIn profile extraction of email and phone, authentication aware workflows, and SalesPlay API integration. Improved prospecting efficiency by 40% , lowered manual data entry by 90%, and made a lightweight extension experience optimized for faster user adoption.

Modernized legacy frontend build infrastructure by integrating Vite packaging into an existing Webpack-based React application,

reducing build times by 60% and streamlining migration workflows across multiple modules.

Redesigned the Webpack build pipeline using Terser minification, CSS optimization, Brotli/Gzip compression, and modular chunk

splitting, Turborepo for independent deployments, reducing bundle size and improving caching and page-load performance.

Designed a robust Java-based authentication and access-control framework with Spring Security and JWT, securing user endpoints

and reducing security-related incidents by 40%.

Implemented scalable and fault‑tolerant Java/Spring microservices with caching + rate limiting, reducing p95 latency under load and

improving resilience.

Led the end-to-end design and implementation of the SalesPlay UI layer as the UI Lead, using React.js—boosting system

responsiveness by 30%, streamlining customer journeys, and driving adoption across multiple product lines..

Architected and delivered a scalable, database-driven UI framework, enabling rapid UI deployment and cutting development time by

80% across cross-functional teams.

Engineered a hybrid MongoDB and SQL architecture, enhancing data retrieval performance and supporting complex analytics use-cases by leveraging Pandas and NumPy for high-speed data aggregation and transformation, resulting in a 30% reduction in average query latency and improving data throughput by 60%.

Crafted and deployed highly reusable UI components including tables, cards, and containers with full support for recursive rendering of

deeply nested data structures, enhancing scalability, maintainability, and code reusability across the application.

Built scalable event-driven services using Kafka for durable event streaming, Redis for low-latency caching , pub/sub messaging for

real-time client updates supporting high-frequency, high-throughput workloads with better resilience.

2022-2025

HIGHRADIUS - Hyderabad, India

ASSOCIATE SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Owned development to modernize legacy systems using React.js, Java, and Spring, driving a 40% uptick in platform performance and

scaling usage to over 1,000 concurrent enterprise users.

Instituted data-driven workload balancing through custom round-robin algorithms in Java & Spring, expediting delivery of high-impact

projects and achieving a 50% reduction in delivery times.

Optimized back-end architecture, slashing operational costs by 40% and amplifying application speed by 50% through SQL tuning and

Redis integration.

Pioneered automation in business processes by implementing a digital booking solution, minimizing labor costs by 30% and office

overhead by 10%

Enhanced software quality through the automation of testing pipelines with PuppeteerJS and Angular, elevating test coverage and

system reliability by 80% for AI-powered modules.

EDUCATION LOVELY PROFESSIONAL UNIVERSITY , B.TECH ECE 8.02 CGPA , 2019 - 2023

AWARDS & ACHIEVEMENTS

● Highako of the quarter Q4 2022-2023 Recognized as Highako of the Quarter (Q4 2022-2023) for delivering critical project milestones

30% ahead of schedule and achieving 95% client satisfaction

Facilitated an engaging online workshop on IoT and ML, resulting in the creation of a dedicated community forum that now supports 50+

ongoing discussions and knowledge-sharing among participants.
